source: Source-code inventory, not visual/functional browser QA

items.name: Room shell, floor and beams
items.gate: one consistent coordinate frame; visible walls not intersecting openings

items.name: Five-drawer cabinet body and tracks
needs: actual hollow drawer recesses, not a solid box
items.gate: closed, 50%, 100% drawer travel, switch and reverse without collision

items.name: Cabinet drawer Finished
items.interaction: slide along calibrated local drawer axis
items.gate: same pivot, scale and travel in all camera states

items.name: Cabinet drawer Drafts
items.interaction: slide along calibrated local drawer axis
items.gate: same pivot, scale and travel in all camera states

items.name: Cabinet drawer Oddities
items.interaction: slide along calibrated local drawer axis
items.gate: same pivot, scale and travel in all camera states

items.name: Cabinet drawer Fragments
items.interaction: slide along calibrated local drawer axis
items.gate: same pivot, scale and travel in all camera states

items.name: Cabinet drawer Field Notes
items.interaction: slide along calibrated local drawer axis
items.gate: same pivot, scale and travel in all camera states

items.name: Folder props and examination surface
needs: only approved metadata can render on labels
items.gate: extractable from every drawer without unapproved work invention

items.name: Desk frame, top and drawers
needs: stable tabletop props and raycast targets
items.gate: desk and typewriter focus are legible, no clickable occlusion

items.name: Paper piles and movable manuscript sheets
needs: mesh hierarchy for real object motion
items.gate: sheet moves while the desk remains fixed

items.name: Desk lamp
items.gate: warm light without visible model/light mismatch

items.name: Bookcase frame and individual books
items.interaction: selected book slides on shelf depth
needs: modelled books with distinctive but coherent shapes
items.gate: book retrieval from close camera, no shelf clipping

items.name: Typewriter body, keys, platen and paper
needs: accurate hierarchy for keys and platen
items.gate: key press and paper advance visually distinct

items.name: Wastepaper bin and loose fragments
needs: paper cluster not clipping solid container
items.gate: paper rummage can be observed from bin camera

items.name: Exit door, frame and handle
needs: door opening cut into side wall
items.gate: open doorway shows meaningful depth and return route

items.name: Window and exterior island silhouette
needs: actual opening, not sky plane pasted over wall
items.gate: floating islands stay legible and behind frame from camera

items.name: Patterned rug
needs: readable stylised pattern, not photographic carpet
items.gate: pattern scale consistent and affordable

items.name: Loose books and decorative objects
needs: storytelling without confusing active object hotspots
items.gate: prop silhouettes don't hide hero objects

items.name: Architectural detail and room stories
items.gate: no clashing cut-out/collage visual language

items.name: Dust motes and subtle atmospheric particles
items.gate: measured GPU cost and restrained visibility

items.name: Hidden compartments or additional puzzles
needs: clear user value before scope expansion
items.gate: must not delay v1
